sotaAssessment.reason: Same-project baseline/current measurements, not matched external peer comparisons. Synthetic workloads and local parser timings do not establish an end-to-end or general SOTA claim.
sotaAssessment.existingScopedSotaUnaffected: The historical X5 INSP first-preview comparison against Photo Sphere Viewer remains a separate, sample-specific result. It does not rank vendor-calibration parsing.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Equivalent external implementations for the same task and output requirements
Representative inputs with full output/visual verification
At least seven alternating repeats per implementation; paired bootstrap 95% speed-ratio lower bound above 1
Publish measurement boundary, input/version hashes, environment, and all slower or failed cases

excludedDiagnostics: metadata probes initially built under the same Cargo package/bin name reused a shared cached WASM; these identical-artifact results are excluded. Final probes use distinct names and assert unequal hashes.
The first small probe build failed because the standalone harness omitted crate::decode_base64; the harness now copies the unchanged production helper.
Initial three-repeat archive measurements and metadata pilot runs are retained separately.
The first seven-repeat 100k archive series overlapped one probe compilation; diagnostic copy retained and series repeated without competing build/test work.
limitations: Generated archive shapes and metadata cases; no broad corpus claim.
Archive navigation times include direct calls to session.setRoute through complete DOM construction, exclude layout/paint, import/transfer and verification.
Metadata times are direct parser work in a standalone WASI harness, not total preview/conversion latency.
Peak memory and multi-thread scalability were not measured.

directoryEquivalence.includes: duplicate names, leading/repeated slashes, explicit directories, file/directory name collisions, Unicode and dot segments

localReproductionArtifacts: tmp/bbtree-followup-2026-10-27 contains original harnesses, source snapshots, production WASM and complete parser output signatures. This ignored local directory is supplementary; the accepted measurements and checks are embedded here.
